title: ARDS X-Ray.jpg
author: Samir 04:51, 17 September 2007 (UTC)
caption: Anteroposterior chest radiograph showing diffuse bilateral pulmonary infiltrates characteristic of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS).
alt_text: Chest X-ray demonstrating bilateral patchy alveolar infiltrates in severe acute respiratory failure.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates radiographic findings of severe parenchymal respiratory failure; terrestrial ICU imaging is limited to portable ultrasound/limited X-ray in spaceflight.
